experiments.scope: Published39-round semi-free-start pair and exact transplant/advice identities only. Trial0 checks claw recovery, exact rows16/17 fibres, downward inversion and256-candidate advice slice; trials1..255 check255 chaining-value identities. Ordinary-message success is justified separately by the proof.
experiments.hypothesis: All fixed algebraic/KAT outputs are hard-asserted; GEN_C and the cryptographic construction are unchanged from0b2616e. No empirical full-attack success probability is inferred from these observations.

experiments.scope: ID21/age10/MAXS768/CUTP256 correctness replica. Trials0..3 run four2^22 windows with updated WIN_EXP counters (3250 distinct claws), exact map/filter checks, fixed aggregate histogram and lag1 checks. Trial4 checks park/resume/cut, near-ID stop/drain, and an explicit two-lane partial-hit-group exhaustion fixture.
experiments.hypothesis: Unmodified standalone source uses constant575000 generation billing, matches all fixed known-answer counters and retains recovery/packing invariants. These correctness-only probes are excluded from the73-row absolute endpoint; they do not prove iid, H5 or full-scale yield.

experiments.scope: Tail replica of proof Section 8 (run 01 of 14): trial 0 runs verify_smc_stats() (hard-asserting stage-18 direct Monte Carlo calibration c18 = 206/65536 and the packed 14-run table EXP with the one-sided 99% and 99.9% Student-t lower bounds above QDECL = -75.47) and the SMC over E18..E23 of the carrier K_P (800 particles; variance-balanced stage lanes 8x512, 8x2048, 8x2048, 4x128, 6x256, 1x4; lazy pool entries) with a known-answer check on the published pair; trials 1 to 20 draw W8 in F8 and W9 in F9 for every proposal (80 x 2048 each; every particle drives exactly two batches), rebuild rows 24 to 38 and verify every hit by the two 39-step compressions, asserting exact match with EXP['r39-tail-01'].
experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39tail.py (EXP and verify_smc_stats()): kat == 1, mask_viol == 0, calib_c18 == 206, lin_lcb_ok == 1, stage counts k18..k23, log2_carrier, and the run's total verified collision hits and parity classes match EXP['r39-tail-01'].
